headline: Alex Adds Thunderpower as Payton Reboots the Backfield
verdict: Alex is the current winner, earning the stronger B grade and a decisive edge in value and lineup impact.
summary: Alex paid Javonte Williams’ 76.8 package value for Derrick Henry and Mike Evans, a 143.4 return that explains the stronger 86.6 overall score, 88.7 value mark, and 82 lineup-impact rating. Henry brings a search rank of 7, a 15.7 season average, and a 26.1 recent average, while Evans adds a 15.1 recent average despite a 4.7 season mark. Payton receives the younger single-piece return in Williams, whose 76.8 value and 14.3 season average offer a useful foundation, but the package gives up Henry’s premium profile and Evans’ recent production. The Retirement Home still has McCaffrey, so this is hardly a roster funeral—but Alex gets the headline haul.
